The discussion focused on the company's process for handling large data files. [me] confirmed that while Google Drive is used for small/medium files, large files are generated internally and uploaded to Amazon S3.
[p1] clarified that the need was only for a one-time transfer of sample files from a data provider, not a regular setup.
[me] suggested that Anatolii could assist by creating a public bucket on S3 and offered to contact him to facilitate communication with [p1].
decisions: Large data files are uploaded to Amazon S3.
